verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live production API platform, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the pack documents user-issuable API credentials, OAuth scopes, or least-privilege tokens. The 'agent' sign-up and client-authorisation material refers to human tax agents (accountants), not scoped API credentials for a software agent, so it earns no credit here.
